neighbours.label: Winning people over: persuading or pleasing them ('persuaded to', 'talked into', 'keep the guests happy', 'get buyers interested')
fire: Good hosts work hard to keep their guests happy.
The airline gave vouchers to keep passengers satisfied.
After long talks, the minister was persuaded to sign.
My sister talked me into buying the tickets.
He tried to convince the jury to acquit his client.
The coach's only aim is to keep the owners happy.
The company is trying to get young buyers interested in its cars.
Lobbyists pressed the council and persuaded it to drop the fee.
quiet: Good hosts work hard to keep their guests fed.
The airline gave vouchers to keep passengers moving.
After long talks, the minister was ordered to sign.
My sister drove me to the station for the tickets.
He tried to show the jury a photo of his client.
The coach's only aim is to keep the players fit.
The company is trying to get young buyers financing for its cars.
Lobbyists met the council and asked it about the fee.

predictions: Persuading or pleasing wording fires, other actions on the same people stay quiet. 'keep X informed' was a leak in probes, so some near misses may fire.
